concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies section vs spec.md:Edge Cases (target fallback)
concerns.text: The spec's target-fallback edge case (no Bulk Modulus → Shear Modulus → Formation Energy with justification note, halt only if neither available) is claimed covered by T002, but no task implements the fallback sequence. T002 is a fetcher; T003's targets.py only constructs the Bulk residual. Add a task or extend T003/T004 to implement the fallback chain.

concerns.location: tasks.md vs plan.md:Project Structure (scripts/pii_scan.sh, update_state_file, validate_citations)
concerns.text: Plan elements with no implementing task: (1) `scripts/pii_scan.sh` / Repository-Hygiene PII scan (Constitution III, plan Constitution Check row III); (2) `update_state_file()` in code/main.py writing artifact hashes to state yaml (plan Principle V row); (3) `validate_citations()` in code/utils/validation.py (plan Principle II row). None of T001–T010 creates these, so the plan's declared verification mechanisms are uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 vs plan.md:Technical Context and T002/T007
concerns.text: T001's pinned requirements.txt omits `mp_api` (T002 imports it), `compositional` (plan's ILR library), and `matplotlib` (T007's parity/PDP plots). The dependency task does not cover what later tasks import; the isolated venv will fail.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 vs tasks.md:T005–T007 and plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: T004 writes result rows to `code/data/results/` while T005/T006/T007/T009 write to `code/results/` (plan's layout). Two different results locations are named; the plan's `results/` element is only partially covered and `--stage all` artifact checks will diverge.

FR-004 names four residual targets (Bulk, Young's, Shear, Poisson's Ratio); T005 covers them only via the unverifiable phrase 'other residual moduli where available' with no deliverable or verification for those targets. Either make the available-targets enumeration a concrete verified output of T003/T005 or narrow FR-004 with justification.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs plan.md:Project Structure (features/pipeline.py VIF check)
concerns.text: Plan's `code/features/pipeline.py` with the VIF check (Complexity Tracking lists VIF as required to keep standard descriptors orthogonal to the Miedema baseline) has no implementing task; T003 covers descriptors.py/exclusion.py only.

Coverage map cites 'FR-002 (US-1): T003' but omits FR-002's Direct-Target clause (Miedema features MAY be included for Direct Target models). No task trains a Direct Target model; if intentionally descoped, state so explicitly rather than leaving the FR clause unmapped.
